goal_title: Write code evolution tutorials for anchor artifacts
why: An evolution.json turns an artifact's code into a playable tutorial — 8 stages from empty to complete, with thinking narration. Currently 4/175 maps have evolutions. Each anchor evolution unlocks its map both on the web player and the VR code evolution screen. This is the lowest-friction way to move every map from 'silent' to 'teaching'.
success_criteria: One evolution.json per sequence anchor artifact (19 total)
Each evolution follows the framework: concept_layer, technique_first/reference, domain_deferred, capture_leaks, limit, 8 stages
The red thread holds: each evolution opens by referencing the previous truth, ends with its own truth

tasks.title: Evolution: Trans_Rotation anchor
tasks.spec: Write commons/maps/Trans_Rotation/evolution.json. Anchor artifact is rotation_gimbal. Follow the framework in doc/curriculum_audit/_framework.md and the template at commons/maps/Point_One/evolution.json. Open stage must reference Trans_Translation's truth ('translation requires direction and magnitude'). Include: concept_layer ('rotation as angular transformation'), technique_first (Quat, axis-angle, gimbal), technique_reference (Basis from Point_Line, Transform3D from Trans_Translation), capture_leaks (non-commutativity, gimbal lock, quaternion needed). 8 stages ending with an identity block.

tasks.title: Evolution: Color sequence anchor (Color_Flashlight + flashlight_demo)
tasks.spec: Write commons/maps/Color_Flashlight/evolution.json. Anchor artifact flashlight_demo. This is the gate+thesis map of the color sequence. Reference Trans_Translation's truth in opening. Introduce: Color as RGB triple, emission, light accumulation. Capture leaks: perception (SimultaneousContrast), metamerism (MetamerismLab), subpixel representation. 8 stages ending with an identity block. See doc/curriculum_audit/color.md for the sequence's concept arc.

tasks.title: Evolution: Forces anchor (ForcesFoundations + example_2_1_forces_vr)

Introduce Newton's F=ma. technique_first: force vector, mass, acceleration, Vector3 operations. capture_leaks: friction (2_4), gravity (2_3), fluid (2_5), composite forces (ForcesComposition). 8 stages. See doc/curriculum_audit/forces.md.
